fixture_catalog.statement: Fresh lifecycle: empty vault, first load, reload, and unload with an active timing record.
Settings and migrations: saved preview defaults followed by manual Chinese and custom values.
Parser grammar spanning valid, invalid, zero, progress, completion, formatting, marker, empty, and nested forms.
Reference ownership with direct and nested block references plus source mutation.
Greedy capacity with overlaps, touching events, fragmented gaps, overload, and fit-fragmentation.
Day relation and playback across dates and controlled workday clock phases.
Spiral progress, completion, reopen, cleanup, and fixed-event retention.
Historical Planned and Actual anchors, sessions, open clocks, cross-midnight records, and over-plan actuals.
Responsive surfaces at canonical widths plus sidebar, themes, reduced motion, and debug state.
Primary selection with multiple renderers, prefixes, and direct versus nested tasks.
CLOCK lifecycle across Clock In, reselection, switch, Clock Out, restart, overlap, and completed owner.
Timing retention and alarms around Recent, POMO, and forgotten thresholds.
Standalone POMO across reload, threshold, stop, and same-tick CLOCK precedence.
Execution views and actions across running, paused, completed, tracked, untracked, scheduled, and overflow states.
Commands and navigation across setting, focus, context menu, sidebar, and failure states.
Failures and localization across writer conflict, injected API failures, locales, and unavailable command API.
Traceability manifest and exact-candidate Evidence Index linkage.
Obsidian host command, menu, notice, navigation, and singleton view workflows.
Canonical visual geometry, breakpoint, theme, state, and text-fit matrix.
Keyboard, focus, screen-reader, reduced-motion, and 200 percent zoom matrix.
Vault write allowlist, stale target, conflict, malformed input, and failure-injection matrix.
Repeated enable, disable, open, close, reload, and unload lifecycle matrix.
English and Simplified Chinese key equality and canonical surface matrix.
Network interception and telemetry persistence matrix for every acceptance fixture.
Deterministic package, scope declaration, policy, install, upgrade, uninstall, and sign-off matrix.

environment_catalog.statement: Pinned repository toolchain and lockfile on CI Linux, fake clock, en and zh-CN locales, UTC, Asia/Shanghai, and America/New_York time zones, including DST transitions.
Pinned Playwright Chromium on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, DPR 1, 100 percent zoom, 1440x1000 viewport, controlled fonts and clock, canonical widths, themes, and reduced motion.
Exact Obsidian, Electron, Chromium, OS, locale, and theme versions for the intended private-vault installation.
Resolved minimum-supported Obsidian on one supported desktop OS with exact app, Electron, Chromium, and OS versions.
Resolved current-stable Obsidian on the supported macOS major version across themes, locales, and zoom levels.
Resolved current-stable Obsidian on Windows 11 across themes, locales, and zoom levels.
Resolved current-stable Obsidian on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS across themes, locales, and zoom levels.
Canonical current-stable host plus versioned high-contrast and heavily customized community themes.
Current macOS with VoiceOver plus automated accessibility checks in ENV-VIS, reduced motion, and 200 percent zoom.

requirements.statement: Given Extension not installed; when Follow preview install instructions; the observable result is English says Depot PR `1430` and shorthand `404KSG+roam-nautilus-log+1430`; Chinese says PR/shorthand `1428`; Acceptance also requires The correct v1.0.2 preview route is unknown; preserve as research unknown, not product behavior.

Given first Obsidian load; when Spiral Day is enabled or installed; the observable result is that native views, commands, settings, and lifecycle disposers are registered in order with zero vault writes and no `roam/render` page, template block, code block, or ClojureScript child. Acceptance also requires idempotent registration and no search for or alteration of legacy-extension blocks.

Given Renderer block mounted; when Extension startup pending / unavailable; the observable result is Pending text is `Loading Nautilus Log...`; unavailable text is red `Extension not installed. To use Nautilus Log, install it from Roam Depot.`; Acceptance also requires Running state is polled every 5 seconds.

Given Extension loaded; when Settings or block content changes; time passes; the observable result is Mounted chart reacts to direct-child pulls, runtime settings events, current minute, and whether its page is today's Daily Note; Acceptance also requires Installation polling is 5 s; time/Daily-Note relation polling is 60 s; CLOCK cache is 15 s when Execution runtime is absent.

Given Extension loaded; when Unload/disable extension itself; the observable result is Renderer/runtime/topbar/commands are removed; no graph content is deleted or rewritten; an active CLOCK is not closed on unload; Acceptance also requires Teardown calls timing stop with `closeActive:false`; this differs from turning Execution Layer off.

Given Fresh install / pre-migration install; when First load; the observable result is Defaults: language `en`; start `5`; end `21`; prefix `[[Nautilus Log]]`; legend max `22`; untimed task `15`; urgent trigger empty; Execution off; sidebar fronting on; POMO `45`; Recent `45`; forgotten warning `120`; Acceptance also requires Old preview empty prefix resets to default and end `24` resets to `21` once; old language resets to English once, then a manually selected `zh` persists.

Given Settings panel open; when Change Language; the observable result is Choices `en`, `zh`; panel labels switch immediately and mounted surfaces receive the new runtime setting; Acceptance also requires Invalid/missing saved value normalizes to `en`.

Given the Obsidian Settings panel is open; when Chart Start or End changes; the observable result is Start choices `5,6,7,8`, End choices `18,19,20,21,22,23,24`, persisted plugin settings update, and chart bounds update immediately in every mounted projection. Acceptance also requires no arbitrary start minute or hour outside these lists and no renderer-template rewrite.

Given the Obsidian Settings panel is open; the Component Prefix control is not exposed because native ItemViews generate no component render text. A migrated custom or empty prefix remains stored but ignored, and Primary Plan discovery uses the canonical Plan Region plus authoritative identity. Acceptance also requires legacy prefix data never to hide an otherwise valid Primary Plan and no Markdown rewrite.

Given Settings panel open; when Select Legend Max Length; the observable result is Choices `14,16,18,20,22,24,26,28`; wide labels truncate by measured available width; Acceptance also requires Renderer accepts only `15..30`; choosing `14` falls back to `22`, despite the visible setting remaining `14`.

Given Settings panel open; when Select Default Todo Duration; the observable result is Choices `5,10,15,20,25,30,45,60` minutes; used when a flexible row has no duration token; Acceptance also requires Explicit zero-duration syntax is not replaced by this fallback.

Given Settings panel open; when Enter Urgent Trigger Word; the observable result is All whitespace is removed; token-boundary match colors a flexible task urgent red; trigger remains visible in the cleaned label; Acceptance also requires Empty trigger disables urgency; it changes color, not scheduling priority.

Given the Obsidian Settings panel is open; when Execution Layer is toggled on; the observable result is a plugin-owned Execution entry, runtime poller, three palette commands, conditional editor commands, and dependent settings. Acceptance also requires default-off to register no panel, poller, commands, or CLOCK writer and any activation failure to reset the setting off.

Given Execution Layer on; when Toggle Execution Layer off; the observable result is All open CLOCKs are closed/confirmed, standalone/task POMO cleared, and entire execution UI/commands removed; Acceptance also requires If closing/confirmation fails, UI remains enabled and setting is restored to true.

Given Execution Layer is on; when Keep Active Task first in sidebar changes; the observable result is a Boolean setting, default on, controlling automatic singleton `ActiveTaskView` opening and fronting after Clock In or switch. Acceptance also requires a fronting failure to warn while the successful CLOCK mutation remains.

Given Execution Layer on; when Select Pomodoro Threshold; the observable result is Choices `15,20,25,30,45,50,60,90`; elapsed text becomes red at threshold but keeps counting; Acceptance also requires Shared by task-bound cycle and standalone POMO; never auto-stops.

Given Execution Layer on; when Edit Recent Retention / Forgotten Timer; the observable result is Numeric minutes; blank is ignored; finite values round and clamp to `>=0`; invalid nonblank resets to `45` / `120`; `0` disables corresponding behavior; Acceptance also requires Input UI is free numeric text, not a select.

Given an existing mounted Planner; when any chart setting changes; the observable result is that the open projection immediately follows current validated runtime settings even when migrated stored data or mounted state is stale. Acceptance also requires runtime settings to take precedence and no serialized renderer arguments or template rewrites to exist.

Given Nautilus renderer under a Daily Note; when Add/reorder direct children; the observable result is Nonempty direct children are read in Roam block order; nested descendants are ignored by the spiral; Acceptance also requires Empty-string children and labels that become empty after cleaning are omitted.

Given Direct nonempty child; when Enter plain text with no TODO marker or time range; the observable result is Spiral treats it as a flexible task; v1.0.2 Execution Plan/Timing/Review omit it because they require TODO/DONE; Acceptance also requires README says flexible tasks are unfinished TODOs. Exact parity must retain this cross-surface disagreement.

Given Direct child; when Include first duration token; the observable result is Case-insensitive forms are arbitrary nonnegative integer `Nh`, `Nm`, `Nmin`, `NhNm`, `NhNmin`; docs name `30m`, `30min`, `1h`, `1h30m`; Acceptance also requires Token must be whitespace-delimited; decimals do not parse; first matching token wins; absent token uses configured default.

Given Direct flexible child; when Use `0m`; the observable result is Row remains parsed but occupies no scheduled minutes and is not overflowed; Acceptance also requires It can therefore be absent from visible scheduled/overflow slices while still existing in Execution Plan; no dedicated test settles desired presentation.

Given Direct child; when Enter a time range; the observable result is Fixed event recognized from 1/2-digit hour, optional `:MM`, optional AM/PM; separators `-`, en dash, `az`, or `to`; end AM/PM is inherited by start; Acceptance also requires Invalid hour/minute makes parser return no range, so spiral falls back to flexible-task treatment.

Given Valid fixed event; when End precedes/equal start; the observable result is Earlier end becomes next-day end and is clipped at 24:00 with overnight warning; equal times produce zero range and same-time warning; Acceptance also requires `23:00-00:00` maps end to 24:00 but the condition emits no overnight warning, contradicting the general guide claim.

Given Flexible task; when Add `dN%`; the observable result is Planned remaining duration is reduced by progress, clamped 0..100; `60m d50%` occupies 30 minutes exactly once; Acceptance also requires Renderer floors percentage result; shared scheduler normalizes it for Execution.

Given DONE flexible task; when Add completion anchor `dH` or `dH:MM`; the observable result is Anchor supplies end time for a Planned fallback slice or end anchor for condensed Actual history; Acceptance also requires Anchor is considered only for DONE; syntax is permissive and undocumented.

Given Direct child; when Use Markdown link, wiki link, emphasis/highlight, embed wrapper, task marker, duration/progress/time syntax, or `---`; the observable result is Display label keeps Markdown link text but removes target; strips wiki delimiters, formatting, recognized metadata, embed wrapper, and horizontal rule; Acceptance also requires Urgent trigger remains in label; empty cleaned label disappears.

Given Task marker present; when Use `{{[[TODO]]}}` / `{{[[DONE]]}}` versus simple `{{TODO}}` / `{{DONE}}`; the observable result is Execution accepts both forms; renderer's explicit DONE/cleanup recognition only covers wiki-bracket forms; Acceptance also requires Simple marker can leak into chart label or fail chart DONE semantics while Execution recognizes it.

Given Direct child contains block references; when Enter one or more `((source-uid))` tokens; the observable result is Spiral replaces each resolvable token from the child's `block/refs` with source text for parsing/display while retaining wrapper UID; Acceptance also requires Resolution is one pass in renderer; nested/recursive references are not a v1.0.2 contract.

Given Direct child is bare reference to TODO source; Execution on; when View in Plan then Clock In; the observable result is Plan projection resolves source content but preserves wrapper UID; Clock In validates the wrapper's own current string, which has no TODO marker and can reject with `Only an unfinished TODO...`; Acceptance also requires Test proves resolved projection, but no v1.0.2 end-to-end reference mutation test settles ownership UX.

Given Today's Daily Note; when Unfinished fixed events and flexible tasks; the observable result is Events claim their time; whole tasks fill the first sufficient continuous gaps from the current minute, in direct-child order; tasks never split; Acceptance also requires Deterministic greedy scheduling; completed/zero-duration rows do not consume future schedule.

Given Fragmented free time; when Earlier high-priority task cannot fit current gap; the observable result is Scheduler advances past the blocking event to place that task later; a smaller later task does not backfill the abandoned earlier gap; Acceptance also requires Source-order priority is stronger than packing efficiency.

Given Task cannot fit before workday end; when Render chart/Plan; the observable result is Task appears in overflow panel/Execution section labelled `Unscheduled today`; status is `Overload` if total demand exceeds available, otherwise `No fitting slot`; Acceptance also requires README calls the concept `Today won't fit`; code-facing wording is `Unscheduled today`.

Given Overlapping fixed events; when Render chart/capacity; the observable result is Each event renders; overlap gets dashed conflict styling; capacity subtracts the union, not double-counted minutes; Acceptance also requires Half-open ranges that merely touch are not conflicts; no textual overlap warning is emitted.

Given Chart with workday bounds; when View capacity header; the observable result is Current `Available` is remaining bounded workday minus union of unfinished fixed events; full-day `Available` and `Events` also shown; Planned is unfinished remaining task demand; Acceptance also requires Full event denominator includes completed fixed events; ranges clip to workday.

Given Capacity computed; when View header/status; the observable result is Metric order: `Planned`, then `Remaining` / `Overload` / `No fitting slot`, then `Available`, then `Events`; status precedence is Overload > No fitting slot > Remaining; Acceptance also requires Planned percent is rounded demand/current Available and may exceed 100%; demand with zero Available displays dash; both zero displays 0%.

Given Current time lies in workday/event; when Time advances; the observable result is Flame/burning marker identifies current half-open bucket; it is suppressed for completed events; Acceptance also requires Touching end time is outside the bucket.

Given Displayed page is today; when Render normally; the observable result is Schedule/capacity start at current minute clamped to workday; elapsed overlay, now needle, current Available interaction, and task click interactivity are enabled; Acceptance also requires Time passing reflows unfinished tasks without reordering source blocks.

Given Displayed Daily Note is in past; when Render normally; the observable result is Scheduling begins at workday start; entire workday is elapsed/hatched where unrecorded; no now needle, burning marker, actionable Available hover, or task clicks; Acceptance also requires Remaining capacity is zero although historical plan slices can still render.

Given Displayed page is future or not recognized as today/past; when Render normally; the observable result is Scheduling/capacity begin at workday start; no elapsed overlay/now needle/task clicks; future Available-slot hover remains available; Acceptance also requires Non-Daily pages fall into `other` behavior.

Given Any visible chart; when Start playback; the observable result is Six-second simulation moves cursor start-to-end, recomputes schedule/capacity/elapsed and shows needle/available region; playback button disables; end resets to live state; Acceptance also requires Does not make a non-today chart task-click interactive.

Given DONE flexible task with closed CLOCK sessions on displayed day; when Render spiral; the observable result is Actual is all valid closed sessions clipped to local displayed day, summed before one floor; one condensed slice uses Actual even if longer than Planned; Acceptance also requires Running CLOCK is ignored for completed spiral history; cross-midnight sessions contribute only overlap.

Given HIS-01; when Determine Actual slice placement; the observable result is Slice ends at explicit completion anchor if present, else at latest closed-session end; starts `Actual` minutes earlier; Acceptance also requires Separate LOGBOOK sessions become one spiral slice.

Given DONE flexible task without valid Actual; when Render spiral; the observable result is Falls back to Planned duration ending at explicit `dH`/`dH:MM`; with neither Actual nor anchor, no historical slice is invented; Acceptance also requires Planned history is explicit-anchor-only.

Given DONE fixed event; when Render spiral/capacity; the observable result is Keeps its explicit time range, appears muted as completed, and still contributes to full-day Events denominator; Acceptance also requires Completion does not replace event range with CLOCK Actual.

Given Elapsed interval exists; when Render past overlay; the observable result is Past unplanned hatch is elapsed time minus fixed, scheduled, and completed-history intervals, split at hour boundaries; Acceptance also requires Generated free/Available time does not count as recorded work; hiding completed items does not reclassify their recorded intervals as unplanned.

Given Wide chart (`>520px`); when Render; the observable result is Flat header: Planned/status and Available/Events metrics left; controls and red/yellow/blue legend right; spiral below with external labels/connectors; Acceptance also requires Exact semantic colors: urgent red, event yellow, task blue; adjacent task fills may vary subtly.

Given Spiral visible; when Read timeline; the observable result is Hour sectors form paired 12-hour depth; configured end `24` is labelled `0`; center shows first comma-delimited page-title portion truncated to 16 characters and current time when applicable; Acceptance also requires Now is a red needle; completed tasks/events and past grid are muted.

Given Wide chart; when Hover or keyboard-focus task/event slice or external label; the observable result is Fixed body-level tooltip shows item type, full title, exact range, duration; connector/label emphasize; tooltip flips/shifts inside viewport; Acceptance also requires SVG groups are keyboard focusable/`role=img`; compact layout mounts no hover surface.

Given Wide future/today chart; when Hover/focus blank future slot; the observable result is Tooltip exposes `Available` exact range and duration; current-day slot copy is `Available now`; Acceptance also requires Past Daily Note exposes no actionable slot targets.

Given Today's chart; current minute is inside an unfinished planned task; when Render/time advances; the observable result is Current planned task receives a 2 px semantic-blue outline, stronger label weight, and `aria-current=true`; Acceptance also requires Uses half-open boundaries and only today's plan; no current-task treatment on past/future pages.

Given Wide chart has colliding external labels; when Render/reflow; the observable result is Labels stay outside the spiral on left/right side rails, use nearby vertical rows/tracks, preserve connector reading order, then move farther outward if required; full text remains in title/tooltip; Acceptance also requires Equal-height tie order differs by side so later times continue naturally; compact mode replaces rails with list.
Given Chart visible; when Eye control; the observable result is Toggles completed slices/list visibility; initial state is shown; Acceptance also requires Multiple renders have independent state.
Given Chart visible; when Playback control; the observable result is Runs DAY-04 simulation; button is disabled while active; Acceptance also requires Animation respects reduced-motion preference.

Given Chart visible; when Collapse control; the observable result is Chart collapses to zero height; only expand/collapse control remains visible above it; Acceptance also requires Persistent per renderer instance, including reload.

Given Today's interactive chart; when Click flexible task slice/list row; the observable result is Advances progress by 10 points; at 90% converts TODO to DONE and adds current `dHH:MM`; clicking DONE without progress reopens TODO at `d10%` and removes completion anchor; Acceptance also requires DONE watcher removes progress markers; this interaction is undocumented and lacks a direct behavior test.

Given Renderer invocation's first argument is `:debug`; when Render and toggle extra debug button; the observable result is Extra button toggles global debug state and text `debug is off` / `debug is on`; enabled mode overlays center/geometry markers and prints debug values; Acceptance also requires Hidden, undocumented developer mode; state is shared across renderer instances and not persisted.

Given Container width `<=520px`; when Render; the observable result is Wide header metrics/legend and external labels hide; compact `Overview` disclosure (initially folded) and `Schedule` list appear; hover surfaces are absent; Acceptance also requires At `<=360px`, SVG max height is `48vh`.

Given Compact chart; when Render main vs right sidebar; the observable result is Schedule starts open in ordinary compact render and folded in right-sidebar render; user can toggle it afterward; Acceptance also requires Right-sidebar detection uses Roam sidebar selectors.

Given Renderer replicated in breadcrumb/collapsed path; when Roam mounts replica; the observable result is Component suppresses chart work and reserves no visible space; Acceptance also requires Selectors cover zoom path, breadcrumbs, parent path, collapsed zoom replica.

Given Any layout/theme; when Roam light/dark or OS reduced motion; the observable result is CSS adapts colors to dark themes and reduces animations/transitions to effectively zero; Acceptance also requires Control opacity is `.38` until chart hover/control focus.

Given Execution Layer on; today's Daily Note has components; when Runtime refresh; the observable result is First matching Nautilus renderer in depth-first Daily Note tree order is Primary Plan; Acceptance also requires v1.0.2 match requires both renderer and literal prefix; multiple charts render, but only first drives execution.

Given Primary Plan found; when Build Plan/Review; the observable result is Only direct TODO/DONE children without fixed time ranges participate; Plan includes TODO only, Review includes TODO and DONE; Acceptance also requires Nested tasks, fixed events, and plain unmarked renderer tasks are excluded.

Given Execution Layer is on; when the plugin-owned Execution entry renders idle or active state; the observable result is a compact idle icon, active elapsed time and distinct thread count, and standalone `elapsed · POMO` with an adjacent stop control. Acceptance also requires elapsed danger styling at the POMO threshold and a non-color warning signal for a forgotten CLOCK.

Given the plugin-owned Execution entry is mounted; when its trigger is activated, outside is clicked, or Escape is pressed; the observable result is an accessible Timing/Plan/Review panel that opens and closes accordingly, with Escape restoring trigger focus. Acceptance also requires the header to contain the Nautilus identity and Timing, Plan, and Review tabs.

Given the Execution panel is open and a Primary Plan exists; when the Nautilus identity is activated; the observable result is authoritative Primary Plan navigation in the main editor and a target flash for about 1.2 seconds. Acceptance also requires no Shift alternate on this identity path.

Given Popover open; when Switch Timing / Plan / Review; the observable result is Timing shows focused plus distinct Recent; Plan shows scheduled plus folded `Unscheduled today`; Review shows state/comparison rows; capacity strip remains on every tab; Acceptance also requires Empty copy distinguishes no active task, no Primary, no unfinished direct tasks, and no Review tasks.

Given Plan tab has tasks; when View rows; the observable result is Scheduled rows show projected range; Unscheduled section shows count/duration and starts folded; task metadata shows remaining versus planned where progress exists; Acceptance also requires Focused row keeps live Timing metadata instead of projected interval.

Given Review tab; when View rows/summary; the observable result is States: completed comparison, `Not tracked` DONE, live TODO, paused TODO, not-started TODO; summary shows completed/total and compared count; Acceptance also requires Planned/Actual/variance totals include only DONE tasks with same-day closed Actual; no comparable rows display em dash; positive variance is over/orange.

Given TODO has open/closed CLOCK; when Review runtime refresh; the observable result is TODO running time is live; TODO with only closed time is paused; DONE comparison uses closed same-day time; Acceptance also requires Actual uses local calendar day, not configured chart bounds; partial minutes sum then floor once.

Given No active CLOCK/POMO; when Click stopwatch in popover header; the observable result is Starts standalone count-up POMO, closes popover, topbar shows elapsed POMO; Acceptance also requires Does not create blocks, affect Review/spiral/Actual, or query graph each second.

Given Standalone POMO active; when Refresh, stop, or Clock In; the observable result is Refresh restores absolute start; `x` stops and clears it; Clock In clears it first; if both restore, CLOCK wins; Acceptance also requires Same-tick mutual exclusion is serialized.

Given a Focused or Recent task row; when its title is activated; the observable result is authoritative task-source navigation in the main editor, while Shift-activation opens or reveals the singleton `ActiveTaskView`. Acceptance also requires this modifier split only for task titles; the `UP-EXE-05` identity path has no Shift alternate.

Given A serialized graph mutation is queued; when Click a timing/completion/delete action; the observable result is Current rows and panel remain painted; affected action buttons become quietly disabled until confirmation; cursor stays default rather than wait; Acceptance also requires The execution surface is not replaced by a blocking/loading view; queued writes remain serialized.

Given Execution on; unfinished TODO; when Clock In from row/context/palette; the observable result is Task becomes focused; one live CLOCK starts; topbar and Timing update; Acceptance also requires Drawer matching is case/whitespace/colon tolerant; canonical form used for creation.

Given Any open CLOCK; when Clock In another TODO; the observable result is Previous open CLOCK closes and new CLOCK opens at the same instant; new task becomes sole focus; Acceptance also requires Serialized mutations enforce one CLOCK globally.

Given Focused task; when Clock Out / global Clock Out; the observable result is Open CLOCK closes; focused clears; task enters Recent if eligible; Acceptance also requires Global Clock Out with no active CLOCK is a no-op.

Given multiple legacy open CLOCKs, an open CLOCK under a DONE or otherwise ineligible owner, or malformed CLOCK source; when the runtime initializes or reconciles; the observable result is a bounded full-LOGBOOK read-only diagnostic with zero Markdown writes. Exactly one valid running CLOCK with a uniquely resolved eligible owner resumes; multiple opens, invalid owners, potential-running malformed records, duplicate identities, and ambiguous legacy times enter the specified recovery state. Acceptance also requires source bytes to be preserved, malformed closed history to be excluded from Actual, newest-valid-wins to be offered only by a separately previewed and confirmed Timing Repair, and DONE-owner closure to use a user-selected trusted instant.

Given Focused row; when Click Complete; the observable result is Closes owned open CLOCK at same instant, converts TODO marker to DONE, and clears focused state; Acceptance also requires Does not add spiral completion anchor `dHH:MM`; if no closed Actual is usable, Review is Not tracked and spiral may show no history.

Given Focused row has current open CLOCK; when Click trash, then confirm within 2500 ms; the observable result is First click arms confirmation; second deletes only current open CLOCK; task remains TODO and drawer remains; Acceptance also requires Confirmation expires after 2.5 s; closed sessions are not deleted.

Given Active/closed tasks exist; when Time passes; the observable result is Recent contains distinct unfinished nonfocused tasks whose latest close is strictly inside retention window, newest first, with ceil-minutes remaining; Acceptance also requires Exactly at boundary is excluded; `0` disables Recent; DONE and focused tasks excluded.

Given First task Clock In; when Continue/switch/reselect/Clock Out; the observable result is Task-bound Pomodoro cycle starts on first Clock In, survives switches and task reselection, and clears on Clock Out; Acceptance also requires Threshold only changes color; it never stops time; reselecting focused task creates no second CLOCK.

Given Open CLOCK; when Elapsed reaches forgotten threshold; the observable result is Topbar shows amber forgotten warning while time continues; Acceptance also requires `0` disables; no auto-stop/delete.

Given Keep Active Task first in sidebar is on; when Clock In or switch succeeds; the observable result is prompt open, reveal, and focus of one singleton `ActiveTaskView`, with no duplicate task leaves. Acceptance also requires navigation to begin promptly and any warning on failure not to roll back the CLOCK mutation.

Given Execution on; when Open Command Palette; the observable result is Exactly three actions, no default hotkeys: `Nautilus Log: 1. Focus current block`; `2. Clock out Timing Line`; `3. Locate Primary Plan`; Acceptance also requires Removed when Execution turns off/unloads.

Given Execution is on and the Obsidian editor context menu is available; when the menu opens; the observable result is `Nautilus Log: Clock in` only for an unfinished TODO and `Nautilus Log: Clock out` only for the current focused task. Acceptance also requires all context actions to be removed on teardown.

Given Existing Roam Logbook-compatible data; when Runtime/chart reads graph; the observable result is Recognizes tolerant LOGBOOK/CLOCK formats; closed sessions remain separate graph records but history condenses by task/day; Acceptance also requires Malformed entries are ignored rather than displayed as Actual.

Given Execution runtime active; when Runtime tick/refresh; the observable result is Elapsed text updates each second; authoritative graph refresh is every 15 s; startup scans all LOGBOOK entries, later refreshes only relevant task UIDs; Acceptance also requires Standalone POMO per-second tick does not query graph/rebuild views.

when Overnight or equal-time fixed ranges; the observable result is Expandable warning panel lists affected rows and localized warning (`Overnight events display only through 24:00` / start and end are same); Acceptance also requires Panel starts collapsed; `23:00-00:00` warning omission is PAR-06.

when Task overflow/fragmentation; the observable result is Expandable overflow list plus `Overload` or `No fitting slot`; task names and durations remain visible; Acceptance also requires Overlap conflicts are visual dashed outlines only, not this warning list.

When Enable Execution is requested, the observable result is a required explicit user attestation that no other CLOCK writer is enabled plus a bounded authoritative CLOCK-index check. If the attestation is absent or the index cannot prove a safe CLOCK data state, a localized danger Notice appears for five seconds, Execution returns off, zero Markdown writes occur, and read-only diagnosis plus Timing Repair are exposed. Acceptance also requires no claim that Spiral Day detected or identified another writer through host state.

when Palette Focus Current without focused block / on non-TODO; the observable result is Warning toast for 5 s: `Focus an unfinished TODO block before starting timing.` / `Only an unfinished TODO can own the Timing Line.`; Acceptance also requires Same validation affects plain/reference wrapper inconsistency.

When Locate has no Primary Plan or authoritative source navigation is unavailable, the observable result is a warning or panel notice reporting `No Primary Nautilus Log was found today.` or the native navigation failure. Acceptance also requires Execution-panel actions to place runtime errors in panel notice state and palette/editor commands additionally to show a Notice.

When an Obsidian Vault read, Editor transaction, Markdown insert/update/delete, source-identity check, or authoritative confirmation fails during a timing action, the observable result is rejection with an operation-specific error; a command path warns by Notice, while the Execution panel shows notice state after refresh and logs the error. Acceptance also requires distinct query/read/write/delete, LOGBOOK/CLOCK creation/closure, current-CLOCK ownership, and task-completion failures, with no success before authoritative reread.

When singleton `ActiveTaskView` opening or fronting fails after a valid Clock In, the observable result is a warning Notice while the CLOCK remains started and the task remains focused. Acceptance also requires Active Task navigation to remain an optional side effect rather than transaction authority.

When any required public Obsidian command registration fails during Execution activation, the observable result is disposal of every partial command, menu, and UI registration; poller/runtime teardown; persisted Execution off; zero Markdown writes; logged host cause; and a localized five-second Notice: `Nautilus Log commands are unavailable. Execution remains disabled.` Acceptance also requires a deterministic visible failure instead of a console-only setting-handler error.

when Browser/host accessibility and focus integration; the observable result is Source declares roles, focusability, labels, Escape restoration, and reduced motion; Acceptance also requires No browser/E2E suite in v1.0.2 proves actual Roam focus order, screen-reader announcement, portal clipping, or sidebar selector survival.

when Refresh/queue lifecycle; the observable result is `Timing data could not be refreshed.`; `The graph change could not be confirmed.`; `Actual Time Tracking is no longer active.`; `Legacy overlapping CLOCK records could not be reconciled.`; Acceptance also requires Popover notice or rejected activation/mutation.

when Task ownership/action; the observable result is `Only an unfinished TODO can own the Timing Line.`; `Only the current Timing CLOCK can be deleted.`; `Only the current running CLOCK can be deleted.`; `Only unfinished TODO tasks can be completed.`; Acceptance also requires Command warning toast or popover notice; no unauthorized write.

When native Markdown read or write capability is unavailable, the observable result distinguishes `Vault read is unavailable.`, `Vault returned unreadable Markdown.`, `Markdown insertion is unavailable.`, `Editor update is unavailable.`, `An authoritative source identity is required for deletion.`, and `Markdown deletion is unavailable.` Acceptance also requires command Notice, panel notice, or activation rejection as appropriate.
